Easy Marble Bundt Cake Recipe!!!
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Saturday, March 31, 2012 - 10:27am

Ingredients




1 box of your favorite yellow cake mix
1 cup of flour – sifted
½ cup sugar - sifted
1 tsp. baking powder - sifted
3 eggs
4 tablespoons butter
½ cup sour milk – let fresh milk plus tsp. of vinegar sit for 15 minutes
1 tsp. vanilla
Marble Mix:
1 tsp. instant coffee
1 tablespoon cocoa powder
1 tsp. brown sugar
1 tablespoon honey
1 tablespoon water

Preparation

1 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 2 In a mix-master combine all of the sifted ingredients plus the butter and mix on low speed. 3 In a separate smaller bowl combine the eggs, milk and vanilla and gently blend with a fork. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients while on a low speed. 4 Butter a bundt pan. 5 In a small bowl combine all of the ingredients for the marble mix and stir. 6 Place the batter in the bundt pan. The batter will be thick, don’t worry. 7 Drizzle the marble mix over the cake and cut through the batter with a knife to incorporate the marble. 8 Bake 35-40 minutes or until the toothpick test comes out clean.

About

This is a perfect cake to serve with a good cup of coffee.
With Love,
Catherine
xo
